story.title: Vect ransomware hitting AI toolchains is actually a wiper — paying ransom recovers nothing
story.summary: Check Point Research has confirmed that organisations hit by supply-chain attacks targeting Trivy and LiteLLM AI toolchain components — and who paid the Vect ransom — almost certainly did not recover their data, because Vect is not true ransomware but a wiper that permanently destroys any file larger than 128KB. The attacks are spreading through AI developer infrastructure that is increasingly integrated into enterprise systems worldwide. Security researchers warn that full data recovery is impossible for victims regardless of whether a ransom is paid.
